execution: migration-fanout, Local backend (STOP B change): one Devin Local subagent per batch on this VM (which can reach the Oracle fixture), at most width=3 at once, then one fresh verifier subagent; orchestrator runs manifest+collision check, breaker, writes result/brief (single ledger writer). child_macro/verify_macro do not resolve on Local: children get skills/install-mongo-kit/playbooks/3-unit_migration.md as a file, the verifier 4-reconciliation_and_parallel_run.md.
expected_cost_note: wave 1 is the calibration wave for two pattern classes: wide-embed (customers, XL 155 cols) and proc-heavy (subscriptions_rating/invoicing/dunning). No later wave to discount against.

batches.brief: Units: customers (CUSTOMER_MASTER + embedded ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE). Source: Oracle OW_BILLING via secret ORACLE_BILLING_RO_DSN (read-only, concurrency 1). Target: Atlas otterworks-demo database mmp_rt_billing via secret MONGODB_MMP_RT_TARGET_URI; write ONLY to mmp_rt_billing.customers. Mapping: .migration/03_mapping_spec.json v1.0.0 (fields, keys, embeds, canonicalization). Tolerances: .migration/02_tolerances.json v1.0.0 (exact). Fixture manifest: .migration/fixtures/ow_billing.json. Loader: Python oracledb -> pymongo bulk_write (replace, upsert) into the declared collections, idempotent by _id. Recon: `recon run` from repo root, --mode fixture until green, then exactly one --mode live --target-class migration_cluster; merge only on live PASS. Never touch Oracle beyond SELECT; never edit .migration/; open one PR per batch against the run branch. XL unit: write the short decision-first contract PR section before code (playbook 3).
